content: Letter 27, to Amīr Fīrūzshāh (ca. 830/1427, Herat?): Ibn Turka complains of torture and imprisonment at the hands of the debt- and tax-collectors of the royal dīvān and confiscation of his property; he thanks the amir for his attention and for ordering restoration of some of it, which will let him care for his family (MK's footnote: or does he request the amir to order this?). He says a group of friends freed him from imprisonment (TMN/M f. 160a; TMN/MS pp. 19-21; TMN/D pp. 188-90; published in Chahārdah Risāla, 295-96).
